  "question": "Assess Aster Silicon's reported packaging queue. I need the following measured result: The median customer packaging lead time in June and September in weeks, with a comparable order definition.",
  "gap": "The median customer packaging lead time in June and September in weeks, with a comparable order definition.",
  "passages": [
    "I began with the underlying record, then checked the units against the stated scope of the exercise.

Aster's accepted-order log reports medians of 24 weeks in June and 17 in September for standard lots; the queue shortened by 7 weeks.

Background to the observation: Aster commissioned its packaging extension in August.

A comparison should use the same unit on both sides. A percentage-point change is different from a percentage change. A nameplate limit is also different from measured delivery under operating conditions.

SYNTHETIC benchmark article. People, records and quantities in this standalone research fixture are invented."
  ]
}
